page.overview:
Who is Bjorn?

Bjorn is the younger brother of Road and a student at the Walrus School on Elbaph.

Bjorn is a young boy with light, straight hair with bangs that cover the left side of his face.

Like other Walrus School students, Bjorn is against violence and fighting. Fittingly, he has shown a bit of cowardice, and was hopeful that he would be saved over his classmates.

Road is Bjorn's older brother. Bjorn has shown embarrassment over Road's otaku nature, demanding that he stay away from his school so as not to let his classmates see him. Despite this, though, he was happy to see him when Road appeared to comfort Bjorn.
